name: NorthRay Files
tagline: A file manager for Windows in the NorthRay look, with creative tools planned.
description: NorthRay Files is a file manager for Windows, being built in stages towards a full alternative to File Explorer. This first preview browses your folders and drives: a sidebar of places and drives, a breadcrumb address bar you can type or paste into, Details and Icons views with Windows' own icons (and the pictures themselves for image files), sorting, selection with the mouse and keyboard, This PC with free space, and plain-words messages for empty, missing and inaccessible folders. Files open in their usual app. It doesn't change, move or delete anything yet: copying, moving, renaming and deleting come next, then tabs and two panes, search and previews, and tools for creative work (galleries, tags and collections).
features: Browse folders and drives, with Home, Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Pictures, Music, Videos and This PC in the sidebar
A breadcrumb address bar: click a part to go there, or type or paste a path (including network paths and %USERPROFILE%)
Details and Icons views with Windows' own icons and file types; in Icons view, pictures show the image itself, turned the right way up; sort by name, date, type or size, in natural order
Select with Click, Ctrl+Click, Shift+Click and the keyboard; type a name to jump to it
Folders load in the background, so even very large ones never freeze the window
Hidden and protected system files stay hidden unless you choose to show them; nothing is changed or deleted in this version
